_meta.purpose: Source data for assets/figures/reallocations-box.svg -- budget reallocations per study. Every value below must be computed by the query in this file, read-only, against Virtual Lab production CockroachDB cluster vprod. Nothing here is typed by hand or estimated.
read_before_use: CLAIMS.md is the authority on what may be published. This file records what the database SAYS.

INCOMPLETE. p10 and p25 are null and the figure CANNOT be drawn until they exist. C-092 records median/p75/p90/max only. A box plot's box spans p25 to p75 and its whiskers span p10 to p90, so two of the five values the form needs are missing. AGENTS.md hard rule 2: never invent a figure, not as a placeholder, not to be replaced later. build-reallocations-figure.py exits non-zero while either is null.

ALWAYS filter by report_type. adopt_reports holds three types -- FACEBOOK_ADOPT (17,596), cost_over_time (7,244) and respondents_over_time (7,226). Only the first is a DECISION; the other two are monitoring. Counting all three gives a median of 84 instead of 61, which is how C-092 was wrong once.
CockroachDB: count(DISTINCT x) returns garbage when it shares a SELECT list with percentile_cont(). Compute distinct counts separately -- this quirk produced a wrong number once already.

population.description: Distribution across studies, each counted once by its own number of budget reallocations.
population.reallocation: One row of vlab.adopt_reports with report_type='FACEBOOK_ADOPT'. One row is one reallocation across every stratum, carrying each stratum's current budget, participants, price per participant and desired share.

axis._note: Set once p90 is confirmed against real p10/p25. The generator exits non-zero if any drawn value falls outside this range, so do not widen it to make a value fit -- that guard is the reason a figure cannot silently clip a claim.

query:
-- Budget reallocations per study. Fills percentiles.p10 and percentiles.p25,
-- and re-confirms median/p75/p90/max, which CLAIMS.md C-092 already carries.
--
-- Run read-only against cluster vprod. The report_type filter is not optional:
-- adopt_reports holds monitoring rows too, and counting them gives 84, not 61.
--
-- percentile_cont is kept away from count(DISTINCT ...) deliberately -- see
-- read_before_use. n_studies is computed in its own statement.

WITH per_study AS (
  SELECT study_id, count(*) AS reallocations
  FROM vlab.adopt_reports
  WHERE report_type = 'FACEBOOK_ADOPT'
  GROUP BY study_id
)
SELECT
  percentile_cont(0.10) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reallocations) AS p10,
  percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reallocations) AS p25,
  percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reallocations) AS median,
  percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reallocations) AS p75,
  percentile_cont(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reallocations) AS p90,
  max(reallocations)                                          AS max,
  sum(reallocations)                                          AS total_reallocations
FROM per_study;

-- Separately, for the reason in read_before_use:
SELECT count(*) AS n_studies FROM (
  SELECT study_id FROM vlab.adopt_reports
  WHERE report_type = 'FACEBOOK_ADOPT' GROUP BY study_id
);
